title: Team
description: A franchise. Deliberately lightweight: a team owns very little data itself — its ROSTER is derived by filtering league.players for players whose teamId matches this team's id. This keeps player ownership in exactly one place and makes trades a one-field update.

id.description: Short, unique, stable team code (e.g. 'BAY'). Referenced by player.teamId, draft.order, history, and transactions.

conference.description: Optional grouping (e.g. 'East'/'West'). Not required by the engine.

championships.description: Running title count, incremented by simulateSeason.js when this team wins it all.

colors.description: Optional cosmetic hex colors for UIs.
